Advanced Weaponry (CC).name: Advanced Weaponry (CC)
Advanced Weaponry (CC).description:
Tu eidolon's attack evolves.

Elige one of tu eidolon's starting melee ataques sin armas. It gains one of the following rasgos, chosen when obtienes the feat: disarm, grapple, nonlethal, shove, trip, or versatile bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing.

Alacritous Action (CC).name: Alacritous Action (CC)
Alacritous Action (CC).description: Tu eidolon moves more quickly. It gains a +10-pies bonificador de estado to its Velocidad.

Amphibious Form (CC).name: Amphibious Form (CC)
Amphibious Form (CC).description: Tu eidolon adapts to life on land and underwater. It gains the amphibious rasgo, allowing it to breathe in water and air and to avoid the normal -2 penalty for making bludgeoning and slashing unarmed Golpes underwater. It gains a swim Velocidad equal to its land Velocidad or 25 pies, whichever is less; or if it is normally aquatic, it gains a land Velocidad equal to its swim Velocidad or 25 pies, whichever is less.

Blood Frenzy (CC).name: Blood Frenzy (CC)
Blood Frenzy (CC).description:
Requisitos Tu eidolon's last action dealt daño de sangrado to a living creature.

Tu eidolon flies into a frenzy. It gains the benefits of @Compendium[pf2e.conjuros-srd.HStu2Yhw3iQER9tY]{Boost Eidolon} and gains temporary HP equal to tu level, but takes a -2 penalty to AC. It can't voluntarily end the frenzy or start another frenzy while in the frenzy.

The frenzy lasts for 1 minute, after which tu eidolon is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 1 minute and can't start another frenzy for 1 minute.

Bloodletting Claws (CC).name: Bloodletting Claws (CC)
Bloodletting Claws (CC).description: Tu eidolon inflicts bleeding wounds on a telling blow. If tu eidolon critically hits with a melee unarmed Golpe that deals slashing or daño perforante, its target takes 1d6 daño persistente de sangrado. Tu eidolon gains an bonificador por objeto to this daño de sangrado equal to the ataque sin armas's bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque. This is a critical specialization effect.

Burrowing Form (CC).name: Burrowing Form (CC)
Burrowing Form (CC).description: Tu eidolon can burrow through loose dirt. Tu eidolon gains a burrow Velocidad of 15 pies.

Constricting Hold (CC).name: Constricting Hold (CC)
Constricting Hold (CC).description:
Requisitos Tu eidolon has a creature @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Tu eidolon constricts the creature, dealing [[/r @actor.level+@actor.abilities.str.mod #bludgeoning]]{daño contundente} equal to tu eidolon's level plus its Strength modifier, with a basic Fortitude save against tu conjuro DC.

Defend Summoner (CC).name: Defend Summoner (CC)
Defend Summoner (CC).description: Tu eidolon blocks attacks against you. After tu eidolon uses this action, obtienes a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC until the beginning of tu next turn. This bonus applies only while estás within tu eidolon's reach (in most cases, this means tu eidolon is adjacent to you or in tu space).

Dual Energy Heart (CC).name: Dual Energy Heart (CC)
Dual Energy Heart (CC).description: A second energy dwells in tu eidolon. Elige an additional energy tipo de daño. Tu ataque sin armas that deals daño de energía gains the versatile rasgo for the second energy tipo de daño, and tu eidolon gains resistance to the second type of daño de energía equal to half tu level.

Eidolon's Opportunity (CC).name: Eidolon's Opportunity (CC)
Eidolon's Opportunity (CC).description:
Desencadenante A creature within tu eidolon's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Tu eidolon makes a melee Golpe against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, tu eidolon disrupts that action. This Golpe doesn't count toward tu multiple attack penalty, and tu multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Golpe.

Eidolon's Wrath (CC).name: Eidolon's Wrath (CC)
Eidolon's Wrath (CC).description:
Tu eidolon gains the @Compendium[pf2e.conjuros-srd.kuZnUNrhXHRYQ2eM]{Eidolon's Wrath} focus conjuro, which it casts, instead of you. Determinas the tipo de daño when obtienes the feat: acid, cold, electricity, fire, negative, positive, or sonic. If tu eidolon is a celestial, fiend, or monitor with an alignment other than true neutral, puedes elige a tipo de daño in its alignment.

Increase the number of Focus Points in tu focus pool by 1. As normal, tu eidolon shares tu Focus Points.

Energy Heart (CC).name: Energy Heart (CC)
Energy Heart (CC).description:
Tu eidolon's heart beats with energy.

Elige an energy tipo de daño other than force. One of its ataques sin armas changes its tipo de daño to the chosen type, and it gains resistance to that type equal to half tu level (minimum 1).

Energy Resistance (CC).name: Energy Resistance (CC)
Energy Resistance (CC).description: Tu eidolon has stronger resistance. Its resistance from Energy Heart and Dual Energy Heart increase to tu level.

Ever-Vigilant Senses (CC).name: Ever-Vigilant Senses (CC)
Ever-Vigilant Senses (CC).description:
Tu eidolon has enhanced senses. It gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to Perception, and can't be flanked except by creatures that are higher level than it.

It can see @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and objects; they appear translucent and are @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto}.

When tu eidolon moves within 30 pies of an illusion that can be disbelieved, the GM rolls a secret check to disbelieve it, even if tu eidolon didn't spend an action to Interactuar.

Expanded Senses (CC).name: Expanded Senses (CC)
Expanded Senses (CC).description:
Tu eidolon evolves more acute senses.

Tu eidolon gains low-light vision and darkvision, as well as scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 pies.

Glider Form (CC).name: Glider Form (CC)
Glider Form (CC).description:
Tu eidolon evolves wings, a buoyant body, or some other means to control descent.

It glides slowly toward the ground, 5 pies down and up to 25 pies forward through the air.

As long as it spends at least 1 action gliding each round and has not yet reached the ground, it remains in the air at the end of tu turn.

Grasping Limbs (CC).name: Grasping Limbs (CC)
Grasping Limbs (CC).description: Tu eidolon grabs enemies. Elige one of the eidolon's ataques sin armas with the grapple rasgo. It gains the @Compendium[pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Tkd8sH4pwFIPzqTr]{Grab} action on that ataque sin armas.

Hulking Size (CC).name: Hulking Size (CC)
Hulking Size (CC).description: Tu eidolon grows substantially. Tu eidolon becomes Large, instead of its previous size, and its reach increases to 10 pies. This doesn't change any of its other statistics.

Magical Adept (CC).name: Magical Adept (CC)
Magical Adept (CC).description: Tu eidolon gains more magic. Elige one 2nd-level conjuro and one 1st-level conjuro of tu eidolon's tradition. Tu eidolon can cast them each una vez al día as innate conjuros. At every even level after sufres this feat, tu eidolon can swap one of these innate conjuros for a new innate conjuro that's 2 or more levels lower than tu highest-level conjuro slot.

Magical Master (CC).name: Magical Master (CC)
Magical Master (CC).description:
Tu eidolon gains a bevy of lower-level conjuros. Elige an innate conjuro of tu eidolon's tradition of each of the conjuro levels from 1 to 7 in which tu eidolon doesn't currently have an innate conjuro from Magical Adept. Tu eidolon can cast each una vez al día as innate conjuros.

Puedes swap these conjuros at every even level, but tu eidolon can never know more than one conjuro of each conjuro level 1 through 7

Magical Understudy (CC).name: Magical Understudy (CC)
Magical Understudy (CC).description: Tu eidolon evolves to cast conjuros. It gains the Lanzar un conjuro activity and learns two cantrips of its tradition, which it can cast as innate conjuros.

Miniaturize (CC).name: Miniaturize (CC)
Miniaturize (CC).description: Tu eidolon can shrink even further. When using Shrink Down, tu eidolon can reduce its size to Tiny

Phase Out (CC).name: Phase Out (CC)
Phase Out (CC).description:
Tu eidolon phases out of reality slightly, gaining resistance to all daño (except force and negative) equal to half tu level. It's not incorporeal, but it can't use Golpes or actions that require a fully physical form, such as @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}.

Tu eidolon can return to its normal form with a single action, which has the concentrate rasgo.

Pushing Attack (CC).name: Pushing Attack (CC)
Pushing Attack (CC).description: Tu eidolon has an attack that pushes away enemies. Elige one of the eidolon's ataques sin armas with the shove rasgo. It gains the @Compendium[pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.t6cx9FOODmeZQNYl]{Push} action for that attack.

Ranged Combatant (CC).name: Ranged Combatant (CC)
Ranged Combatant (CC).description:
Spines, flame jets, and holy blasts are just some of the ways tu eidolon might strike from a distance. It gains a ranged ataque sin armas with a range increment of 30 pies that deals 1d4 daño and has the magical and propulsive rasgos.

When you select this feat, elige a tipo de daño: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, void, piercing, vitality, or slashing. If tu eidolon is a celestial, fiend, or monitor with an alignment other than true neutral, puedes elige a tipo de daño in its alignment.

Resilient Shell (CC).name: Resilient Shell (CC)
Resilient Shell (CC).description: Tu eidolon is resilient against attacks. It gains resistance to daño físico equal to its Constitution modifier.

Shrink Down (CC).name: Shrink Down (CC)
Shrink Down (CC).description: Tu eidolon can shrink to fit into small spaces. Tu eidolon reduces in size, to a minimum of size Small. It can use this action again while shrunk to return to its normal size.

Spell-Repelling Form (CC).name: Spell-Repelling Form (CC)
Spell-Repelling Form (CC).description: Tu eidolon evolves to protect itself from the danger posed by conjuros. It gains a +1 bonificador de estado to all tiradas de salvación against magic.

Steed Form (CC).name: Steed Form (CC)
Steed Form (CC).description: Tu eidolon changes to make it particularly effective as tu mount. While you ride it, you get tu full number of actions each round instead of reducing them to 2. This applies only when you ride tu eidolon, not when anyone else does. Tu eidolon still must be at least one size category larger than you to ride it. Since you work together to move, tu eidolon's move actions while estás mounted gain the tandem rasgo.

Summoner Dedication Adjustment (CC).name: Summoner Dedication Adjustment (CC)
Summoner Dedication Adjustment (CC).description: This feature will adjust the eidolon's stats to be correct for players using the summoner dedication It caps all stats at 16 until the eidolon is level 5.

Towering Size (CC).name: Towering Size (CC)
Towering Size (CC).description: Tu eidolon becomes even bigger. It becomes Huge, instead of Large, and the reach on all its attacks increases to 15 pies.

Trample (CC).name: Trample (CC)
Trample (CC).description:
Tu eidolon Strides up to double its Velocidad and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space it enters. It can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single Trample.

It deals daño contundente equal to the daño of its secondary attack against these creatures, which can attempt a basic Reflex save against tu conjuro DC.

Vibration Sense (CC).name: Vibration Sense (CC)
Vibration Sense (CC).description: Tu eidolon gains @Compendium[pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]{Tremorsense} as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 pies. If aquatic, it gains @Compendium[pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.VdSMQ6yRZ3YXNXHL]{Wavesense} as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 pies instead. If amphibious, it gains both.

Weighty Impact (CC).name: Weighty Impact (CC)
Weighty Impact (CC).description: Tu eidolon knocks enemies down. Elige one of the eidolon's ataques sin armas with the trip rasgo. It gains the @Compendium[pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.BCLvAx4Pz4MLa2pu]{Knockdown} action for that attack.
